title: Oven Roasted Italian Turnip Frittata
description: A salty, aerated Italian dish featuring turnips, perfect for brunch, made with whole30-friendly ingredients and served in a tagliere vessel. This recipe is inspired by the flavors of Puglia, Italy.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and dried oregano.
Add the diced turnips to the bowl and stir to combine.
Heat the olive oil in a large tagliere vessel over medium heat.
Pour the egg mixture over the turnips in the tagliere vessel.
Transfer the vessel to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the vessel from the oven and brush the lacquer glaze over the top of the frittata.
Return the vessel to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the glaze is caramelized.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let the frittata cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
